items.content_text: - **CFTC moves to separate prediction markets from sportsbooks in Pennsylvania-focused report** — Play Pennsylvania reported the CFTC announced two actions on October 9 aimed at distinguishing prediction markets from conventional gambling, including a proposed rule classifying sports and other event contracts as swaps. The actions do not transfer oversight of Pennsylvania licensed sportsbooks and casinos away from the Pennsylvania Gaming Control Board.
